# Power Rescue Electrical

> Power Rescue Electrical is a Gauteng, South Africa electrical company. Registered electricians handle emergency repairs, installations, maintenance, Certificates of Compliance (COCs), solar, inverter and battery backup, solar geysers, electric fences, CCTV and security gate motors for homes and businesses. The emergency line is open day and night. No job is too small.

- Website: https://www.powerrescue.co.za
- Phone and WhatsApp: 063 039 2007 (+27 63 039 2007)
- Email: info@powerrescue.co.za
- Coverage: Gauteng and its outskirts, including Johannesburg, Sandton, Randburg, Roodepoort, Midrand, Centurion, Pretoria, Pretoria East, Kempton Park, Benoni, Boksburg, Germiston, Alberton, Soweto, Krugersdorp and Fourways.

## Services

- [Emergency Electrical Repairs](https://www.powerrescue.co.za/emergency-electrical-repairs): 24/7 call-outs for tripping breakers, no power, burning smells, dead plugs and burnt wiring.
- [Electrical Installations and Wiring](https://www.powerrescue.co.za/electrical-installations): New builds, extensions, rewires and commercial installations.
- [Electrical Maintenance and Fault Finding](https://www.powerrescue.co.za/electrical-maintenance-fault-finding): Inspections, testing and fault finding for homes, offices and complexes.
- [Solar PV Installation](https://www.powerrescue.co.za/solar-installation): Rooftop solar sized to real usage, grid-tied and hybrid.
- [Inverter and Battery Backup Installation](https://www.powerrescue.co.za/inverter-battery-backup): Hybrid inverters and lithium batteries for load shedding.
- [Electrical COC Certificates](https://www.powerrescue.co.za/electrical-coc-certificate): Inspection, repairs and Certificates of Compliance for selling, buying or insurance.
- [DB Board Upgrades and Replacements](https://www.powerrescue.co.za/db-board-upgrades): Old distribution boards replaced with compliant, labelled boards.
- [Lighting and Plug Point Installation](https://www.powerrescue.co.za/lighting-plug-point-installation): Downlights, outdoor and security lighting, extra plug points.
- [Electric Fence Installation and Repairs](https://www.powerrescue.co.za/electric-fence-installation-repairs): New wall-top and free-standing fences, fault finding and repairs.
- [CCTV Installation and Repairs](https://www.powerrescue.co.za/cctv-installation-repairs): New systems, extra cameras and repairs.
- [Security Gate Installation and Repairs](https://www.powerrescue.co.za/security-gates-installation-repairs): Gate motors, automation, remotes, batteries and intercoms.
- [Solar Geyser Installation and Repairs](https://www.powerrescue.co.za/solar-geyser-installation-repairs): Solar geyser installation, elements, thermostats, controllers and pumps.
